reconstructed_values.presentation_pose: Folded carrier study retained for fleet-scale inspectability. Three nested truss stages per side encode a reconstructed 3.5 + 2 x (6.0 + 5.6 + 4.9) m section-length study whose arithmetic equals the published 36.5 m working span; segment allocation, folds and pivots are not manufacturer geometry.
reconstructed_values.carrier_transport_width_note: Manufacturer-published with 710/60R46 tires; axle track setting within that basis remains unresolved.
reconstructed_values.solution_system: Visible tank is a neutral volume cue for the selected 1,600 US gallon liquid system; plumbing and liquid behavior are not simulated.
reconstructed_values.materials: Neutral unbranded slate, graphite, steel, rubber and glass with no logos, decals or copied trade dress.
reconstructed_values.hidden_geometry: Boom hinges, self-centering linkage, suspension anchors, steering joints and plumbing are reconstructed.
reconstructed_values.animation_ranges: Conservative presentation fold and axle ranges only; not operating limits.
